Monologue: What interesting times we are living in, friend.
Never did I imagine that a drunken beggar would dare to challenge me.
Were you aware of his original fate? A lonely death by liver failure, caused by incapability to handle the death of his loved ones.
But instead, he went out smiling.
Charged at me like a fool, all to be some hero for strangers who were beckoning for their hubris to be corrected.
Yet I did not mind it. I granted him his salvation swiftly and without pain, and honored his wish to see those kids safe. Why?
Because, friend, I am here to learn more about this city on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who live and breathe in this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*.
You, my friend, are my final subject. A truly interesting conclusion to my mission.
You can return to your work in peace. This is our final goodbye, friend. There's not much left. I hope you enjoy the dredges of what's left.
